metadata.title: fix(tests): exclude mcp-cli protocol tests from default pytest runs
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- Add `--ignore=tests/e2e/test_mcp_cli_protocol.py` to `pyproject.toml` `addopts` so mcp-cli e2e tests are excluded from default pytest invocations (bare `pytest`, IDE runners, CI)
- These tests require a live ContextForge instance and `mcp-cli` installed, and should only run via `make test-mcp-cli`
- The `make test` Makefile target already had this ignore; this change ensures consistency across all pytest entry points

## Test plan
- [ ] `make test` passes without running mcp-cli tests
- [ ] `pytest` (bare) skips `test_mcp_cli_protocol.py`
- [ ] `make test-mcp-cli` still runs the mcp-cli tests when invoked explicitly

commits.message:
fix(tests): exclude mcp-cli protocol tests from default pytest runs

The e2e/test_mcp_cli_protocol.py tests require a live ContextForge
instance and mcp-cli installed. Add --ignore to pyproject.toml addopts
so they are skipped by default (bare pytest, IDE runners, CI) and only
run explicitly via `make test-mcp-cli`.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
